item.title: Uchi wa Mou, Enki Dekinai.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sonora
  • 発売日: 2021-11-26
  • スコア: 7.49/10 (241 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ウチはもう、延期できない。
  • 英語名: Uchi wa Mou, Enki Dekinai.

别名

  • enking

あらすじ

Spring break. Miyamura Miku, a hobby writer of light novels, is approached by her older sister Miyamura Karin, who reveals to her that she’s working as a voice actress for erotic games.

“The company I am working for right now needs someone to assist with writing the sex scenes!” Karin asks for Miku’s assistance.

item.title: Hibikino-san-chi wa Eroge-ya-san!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sonora
  • 発売日: 2020-11-27
  • スコア: 7.25/10 (164 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 響野さん家はエロゲ屋さん！
  • 英語名: Hibikino-san-chi wa Eroge-ya-san!

别名

  • Hibikino

あらすじ

In the residential district Kamiitsukomachi’s old shopping district lies Hibikino Shop. This general store closed down after the grandfather owning it finally retired.

His three granddaughters, attached to it, and unwilling to let it disappear, decided to renovate it.

Hibikino Shop, loved by its community since 50 years, under the pressure of Yukari, the good for nothing of an eldest sister, became… an eroge store!

item.title: Onaji Class no Idol-san. Around me is full by a celebrity.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sonora
  • 発売日: 2019-09-27
  • スコア: 6.840000000000001/10 (83 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 同じクラスのアイドルさん。Around me is full by a celebrity.
  • 英語名: Onaji Class no Idol-san. Around me is full by a celebrity.

别名

  • おなくらさん

あらすじ

Kentarou’s childhood friend Akari transferred schools a few years ago and they haven’t much contact since. One day, it was decided that he’ll live with his grandfather due to his father’s job transfer. When he arrived at the house, he saw Akari for the first time in a few years. She had enrolled in the celebrity course at Itsuko Gakuen and was living at his grandfather and the board chairman’s house, which had recently been converted to a student dormitory.
